description: Rolling LinkedIn content calendar (docs/LINKEDIN_STRATEGY.md §3, marketing/strategy/social_media_plan.md). 4 fixed posts per week (Tue/Wed/Thu morning + Sunday evening, Europe/Brussels) + up to 2 event-reactive posts (weekly total ≤ 5; a reactive post displaces a fixed slot on conflict). scripts/content_dispatcher.py emails the due draft to the operator one hour before peak browsing; publishing is human-executed.

cadence.dispatch_note: Emails go out one hour before peak LinkedIn browsing: 07:00 before the 08:00–10:00 B2B morning peak, 16:00 before the 17:00–19:00 Sunday evening catch-up. Saturday dropped — weakest B2B day.

reactive_slots.trigger: Real observed climate event (wildfire, flood, heat wave, storm) with an authoritative source; draft from marketing/content/drafts/_template-event-reactive.md within 24h; may carry its own dispatch_at time; displaces a fixed slot so the week stays ≤5.

rules: Every post links to a checkable Talaix page or an authoritative source.
No invented numbers, events, or engagement bait; evidence rules of docs/PRODUCT_STORY.md §8 apply.
Campaign-tagged landing URLs are used when a post belongs to a campaign.
